text: In twenty thirteen, a robot on Mars turned one year old.
So NASA made it sing "Happy Birthday." To itself.
Over two hundred million miles from home.
Singing, it turns out, has no scientific value.
But for its tenth birthday, an army of robot lawnmowers on Earth sang it back.
Nobody should have to sing to themselves.
That's why we made Feeloy. Jenny will always answer.
Search Feeloy on the App Store.
